name: Move Flipkart Seller data to Snowflake
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Flipkart Seller** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Flipkart Seller** account using the **(+)** icon with your **Username & Password.** Check more about the process [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/flipkart-ads/pipelines/pla-search-term-report.html#_data_pipelines_details).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/flipkart-seller/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
